name: Suwa Seika
source:
She is a counselor at the academy. She is popular among the students and well-liked. However, she has already been trained has become a faithful assistant.

 Because she has been drugged and trained for a long time, she has earned his trust, and sometimes she even applies correctional programs to her targets on his behalf.
